bio.text: Jon S. Eubanks is serving his eighth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 46, and chairs the House Rules Committee for the 95th General Assembly.
The legislature lists his occupation as farmer, and his public service as including the Paris School Board and House Speaker Pro Tempore.
He holds a B.S. in accounting from Arkansas Tech and is a past president of the Paris Rotary Club and the Paris Boys and Girls Club.
